version.changelog:
Version 13.0.0 of paid-measurement-loop introduces a detailed skill contract and robust instructions for paid advertising readback decisions.

- Defines a clear process for reading back paid campaign changes and issuing Promote / Keep-testing / Rollback / Unproven verdicts.
- Separates this skill’s scope from roi-calculator (math) and performance-analyzer (cross-channel reporting).
- Requires control selection, readback window discipline, attribution window and currency normalization.
- Delegates all ROAS/CPA math to roi-calculator, focusing on decision logic, window selection, measurement-signal integrity, and result recording.
- Introduces file/data handling guidance and output structure, with an explicit save-to-memory step.

llm.summary: The reviewed skill artifacts are operational and sensitive in places, but their API access and write actions are disclosed, purpose-aligned, and user-directed.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts include skills for ClawHub moderation/releases, Axiom observability, dashboards, alerts, metrics, Sentry issue fixing, Convex setup, and documentation; the observed API calls, token use, deploy guidance, and deletion/update commands match those stated purposes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions generally require explicit targets, dry runs or confirmation for destructive and production actions, and safe handling of untrusted Sentry/log data; no hidden role changes, output manipulation, or unrelated behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No hidden installer or automatic execution hook was identified; setup scripts are user-invoked and mainly check dependencies or create/read disclosed config such as ~/.axiom.toml and ~/.config/axiom-sre/config.toml.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skills can use sensitive API tokens and network access for Axiom, Grafana, Pyroscope, Slack, Sentry, GitHub, Convex, and ClawHub admin workflows, which is proportionate for the operational tasks but should be installed only where those capabilities are intended.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Some persistence is disclosed and task-related, including Axiom SRE config/memory under ~/.config/axiom-sre and Convex local deployment state under ~/.convex; no unbounded background persistence or privilege escalation was observed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want the agent to help with operational workflows. Configure least-privilege tokens, review commands before approving writes, and be especially careful with moderation, production release, monitor/dashboard deletion, Slack/Sentry data, and Axiom/Grafana/Pyroscope credentials.
llm.findings:
[VirusTotal:clean] expected: VirusTotal reported 0 malicious and 0 suspicious engines, which is consistent with the artifact review but was not used as the sole basis for the verdict.
[SkillSpector:clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact inspection did not reveal scanner-missed hidden exfiltration, destructive automatic execution, or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[LocalArtifactReview:operational-api-authority] expected: The reviewed scripts include authenticated API wrappers, monitor/dashboard deletion, production deploy guidance, and moderation actions, but these are disclosed in the skill text and generally gated by explicit user confirmation or operator intent.
